help.tagPrefix: Optional. Prefix for all tags, e.g. 'v' results in 'v1.0.0'. Only tags with given prefix are recognized. Can be omitted or set to '' for no prefix.
help.initialNonPrefixedVersion: Required. Initial version number if no version tag is found. The prefix will be added to it.
help.changelogFile: Required. File to write the changelog to. Set to '' to skip changelog generation (note: --real-run will also skip commit and tag when empty).
help.compareUrlFormat: Optional. URL to compare two versions. Use {{previousTag}} and {{currentTag}} as placeholders. Can be omitted or set to '' to disable comparison links.
help.commitUrlFormat: Optional. URL to a commit. Use {{hash}} as placeholder. Can be omitted or set to '' to disable commit links.
help.issueUrlFormat: Optional. URL to an issue. Use {{id}} as placeholder. Can be omitted or set to '' to disable issue links.
